gloss: reading and study of texts; close reading

definitions.gloss: reading and studying texts closely; close reading; textual study
definitions.explanation: The careful reading and analysis of texts, especially in an academic or classroom setting. Often involves translating, interpreting, and discussing the meaning of texts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文献|ぶんけん}→文献：12885_bunken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{講読|こうどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ドイツ{語|ご}→ドイツ語：28074_doitsugo⟧{講読|こうどく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took a German text reading course at university.

examples.english: In the seminar, we examine the society of the time through close reading of classical literature.

notes:
A compound of {講|こう} (lecture/discuss) + {読|どく} (read). A specifically academic word referring to the close, analytical reading of texts — distinct from casual reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {原書|げんしょ}{講読|こうどく}: reading original texts (in the source language)
- ⟦{文献|ぶんけん}→文献：12885_bunken⟧{講読|こうどく}: study of written materials
- {講読|こうどく}⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧: text reading class
- ⟦{古典|こてん}→古典：00242_koten⟧{講読|こうどく}: classical text study

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{購読|こうどく}→購読：04468_koudoku⟧: subscription — subscribing to publications; same pronunciation, different meaning
- ⟦{精読|せいどく}→精読：15982_seidoku⟧: intensive reading — careful, detailed reading (but not necessarily in a class)
- {輪読|りんどく}: group reading — taking turns reading and discussing a text
- ⟦{読解|どっかい}→読解：15056_dokkai⟧: reading comprehension — understanding written text

NOTE: Be careful not to confuse {講読|こうどく} (text study) with ⟦{購読|こうどく}→購読：04468_koudoku⟧ (subscription to a publication). They are homophones with very different meanings.
